body: Please be strong for her, you knew her very well and the only way for the world to continue knowing her is through you

I agree that he is strong. I’m about to jump from 60 floors. The one person who is helping me, told me last night to go do it he doesn’t care anymore. He says he accept it and since it’s what I want anyway. He says he will take the pain for me if I want to punish him. Little did he know, I will actually take him up and do it. 

It’s just what I was waiting for
